name: Mochizuki Kazune
source: A 17-year-old second-year high school student, she is active and strong-willed, speaking out clearly when she believes she is right. Before transferring to Seiwa High School, where Aki and his friends attend, she lived in London. As a returnee, she struggles with difficult Japanese.
